Strategy: Keep Best Fit ordering but give a bonus to bins just looser than the tightest one, within ten units, so the single tightest bin is preserved for a future item that fits only there. It may help when tight fits are scarce, but may fail by leaving the tightest bin unused while looser bins accumulate.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (40 if r != min(bins) and r - min(bins) <= 10 else 0) for r in bins]
```
